overview: The MGB Biobank README describes daily codified EHR files, monthly unrolled NLP data and a demographics file for the 2025 patients.

sections.title: Storage and access
items: The README places the project on Eris/Partners and raw codified data in MSSQL. Its September 2026 update lists O2 access as pending HMS–BWH DUA acceptance.

sections.title: Daily codified data
items: Daily CSV batches are grouped by diagnosis (Phecode), medication (Med), laboratory (Lab) and procedure (Proc). Raw codified data are in MSSQL.

sections.title: Patients and codes by data type
items: Diagnosis: 156,735 patients / 1,868 codes. Medication: 151,617 / 2,662. Lab: 148,955 / 7,276. Procedure: 155,827 / 248. These are separate counts for each type.

sections.title: Codified date coverage
items: Medication: 1994-01-01 / 2017-01-23 / 2915-08-16 as printed. Confirm the maximum with the curator before using it.

sections.title: NLP
items: Raw NILE output is organized by RPDR note file. Monthly unrolled NLP data are batched by patient.
154,954 patients and 296,265 distinct CUIs including acronyms. Minimum March 1976, median December 2005, maximum July 2025.

sections.title: Demographics
items: The summary table reports 157,963 unique patients. Minimum, median and maximum birth dates are 1912-11-06, 1962-12-18 and 2021-12-03.

Demographic file columns: PATIENT_NUM, BIRTH_DATE, SEX_CD, RACE_CD, subject_id, Race_Cd_updated, EMPI, zip_cd, VITAL_STATUS_Death_Flag, Death_date, Consent_date, race_American_Indian_Alaska_Native, race_Native_Hawaiian_Pacific_Islander, race_White, race_Other, race_Declined, race_Unknown, race_Unavailable, race_Not_Given, race_NOT_REPORTED, hispanic, race_feldman, hcu, empi, Address, Address2, City, State, Zip, hypertension, diabetes, cad, hf, ra.
